trial_outcome.hard_blocker: IAM-v2 CANNOT BE ENABLED BY CONFIGURATION. With STAYCONNECT_IAMV2_MASTER=true, scd refuses to start: 'iamv2 master flag is enabled but no production repository is wired (Phase 2 only)'. The source says the same thing at data-plane/cmd/scd/authsec.go:39-42 -- the repository is deliberately nil and the code returns an error where the wiring belongs, commented 'wiring a real repo here is a Phase 2 cutover step'. edged refuses identically for Phase-2 commerce: 'no production admin repository is wired (cutover only)'. No production implementation of iamv2.Repository exists anywhere in the tree -- only a nil and a test fake.
trial_outcome.why_this_is_not_a_defect_to_fix_forward: Writing that repository IS the atomic complete-domain IAM-v2 cutover implementation, which the FINAL contract defers to a later separately approved gate and which D29 explicitly does not authorize. It is an architecture/business-policy boundary already settled the other way, not an ordinary development defect.
